title: Incubator run metrics
description: One metrics.json per run. Every experiment deposits into this same shape so all runs accumulate into one dataset. The runner writes this file; models never do.

run_id.description: Unique per run, e.g. exp001-c2-r3 (experiment, condition, replicate).

replicate.description: Which repetition of this condition this run is (n=1 is an anecdote; report all replicates).

condition.description: The experimental cell this run belongs to.

authorship.description: Who wrote the planning documents. 'none' = goal-only runs with no documents.

granularity.description: Document decomposition depth given to the builder.

context.description: Session handling: one long session vs. fresh context per task. Separated from granularity to control the context-hygiene confound.

adapter_version.description: Version of the per-model prompt adapter, if any.

prompts_sha.description: Git SHA of this repo at run time — pins the exact stage contracts used.

stages.description: One entry per pipeline stage executed. BUILD appears once per task.

task_id.description: Present only for P5_build entries, e.g. T03.

retries.description: Failed Done Check attempts before success or block (max 3 by contract).

blocked.description: True if the stage ended by writing a BLOCKED file.

interventions.description: Every human touch, no exceptions. Empty array = pure run. In pre-registered pure conditions any entry here voids the run (recorded as outcome 'failed').

level.description: L1 = unblocked (answered a question, supplied missing input). L2 = corrected (redirected a wrong approach). L3 = took over (edited code/docs by hand).

human_minutes.description: Headline metric, not a footnote. Sum of intervention minutes plus setup/review time.

status.description: shipped = all ACs pass. killed = stopped by a kill criterion (a success of the process). blocked = model stopped per contract. failed = run voided (rule violation, intervention in a pure condition, harness error).

quality_score.description: Rubric score from the blinded frontier judge, if this run was judged.

kill_criterion.description: Which criterion fired, when status is killed.
